summary_en: On November 13, 2026, the board authorized a share buyback via ToSTNeT-3 (off-market transaction) at a fixed price of 262 yen per share. Up to 1.2 million shares (3.5% of outstanding shares) will be purchased for a maximum of 314.4 million yen, with settlement on November 16, 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Share Buyback via Off-Market Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
Aida Sekkei's board of directors decided on November 13, 2026, to acquire its own shares via an off-market transaction (ToSTNeT-3) mechanism. The company will purchase up to 1.2 million shares at a fixed price of 262 yen per share, representing 3.5% of outstanding shares (34,538,729 shares excluding treasury stock), for a total amount not exceeding 314.4 million yen. The buyback will be executed through a single transaction order on November 16, 2026, at 8:45 a.m. Tokyo time, with results published immediately after market close that same day.

The company cited two primary reasons for this buyback: improving capital efficiency and enabling flexible capital allocation policies, while positioning the acquisition as part of its shareholder return strategy. The transaction order is limited to the specified trading session and will not be modified; however, the company noted that partial or complete non-execution is possible depending on market conditions. The buyback does not involve a price ceiling, as the purchase price is fixed at the reference price established on the announcement date.
